body:
This seems related to: https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8031748

So basically for `JarInputStream` the manifest needs to be the first entry in the jar

issue.title: Ensure that the manifest of the generated jar is the first entry

labels.name: triage/waiting-for-ci
labels.description: Ready to merge when CI successfully finishes

body: For future reference - Quarkus uses ZipFileSystem for handling the jars. There's a JDK enhancement to help fix this problem within the ZipFS implementation https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8211917. For now the workaround @geoand added has helped us get past this.
